instagram.caption:
Thinking about an AI receptionist? Plumbing and HVAC owners, count missed calls first.
Our worked example (labeled EXAMPLE, not a real shop): 14 missed calls in 2 weeks, 4 were real jobs, $350 cleared a job. 4 x $350 = $1,400 in 2 weeks, call it $2,800 a month.

1. For 2 weeks, mark every missed call on a calendar.
2. Circle the ones that were real jobs.
3. Real jobs x what you clear on an average job.
4. Hold that next to the monthly price on the quote. Price bigger? It can't pay for itself yet. Smaller? Part 2 tries 3 options side by side.

youtube.title: AI Receptionist for Your Plumbing Business? Count Missed Calls First (Part 1 of 2)
youtube.description:
AI receptionist for a plumbing or HVAC business? Count your missed calls first. Part 1 of 2.
The numbers are our worked example, labeled EXAMPLE on screen, not a real shop or customer: 14 missed calls in 2 weeks; 4 were real jobs; $350 cleared a job. 4 x $350 = $1,400 in 2 weeks; call it $2,800 a month.

Steps:
1. For 2 weeks, mark every missed call on a calendar.
2. Circle the ones that were real jobs.
3. Multiply real jobs by what you clear on an average job.
4. Hold that next to the monthly price on the quote. If the price is bigger, it can't pay for itself from missed calls yet.

Next: part 2 tries 3 options side by side: a missed-call text-back, a person answering, and an AI receptionist.
Send this to whoever signs the software bills.
What a missed call costs your shop, free: https://proofnotfluff.com/missed-call-cost-calculator/
